expected_return.window: scorebord: BUY 13:30 ET on the entry day; SELL amc at the next open, bmo at 13:00 ET on the report day; gross

note: Each member is reported as a percentile of its own live range, 0-100 (pct), with its direction in side; panel_pct (0-100) is the size of the mean of the signed percentiles and side its direction; panel_pct_sd their spread. The selection is panel_pct in the top 20%. panel_score is the signed median of the members' sizes, each read against its own recent history. consensus_k counts members that put the name in their own top 20% on the panel's side; that, not sign agreement, is what selected well on the development names. Certainty (p_up) is recorded and decides nothing. expected_edge_pct is a shrunk in-sample prior, not a forecast. Research only.

opus5.note: Rests on Qfin's 11-24 print (item 0) landing after FINV last spoke on 08-27 - volume -40.6% YoY, Q4 net income guided -67/-77%, liquidity tightening one to two more quarters - against a company that already steered to the low end 'unless the operating environment substantially changes', which is the one condition that has clearly been met, and whose own history is -15/-19% on guide disappointment; nearly flat net because that document is one day old and public, FINV already fell 5.4% on 11-25 into a 52-week low 62% off the high, and item 2's arithmetic (the RMB11.5bn low end needs only ~2.44bn a quarter, which a Qfin-shaped revenue path roughly meets) plus the $946m cash and unused $150m buyback (item 3) are real offsets. abs_move is set above the 13.4% indicative implied move on the name's own last two prints (-15/-19%, +15%) and the repo's measured hunter understatement.

opus55.note: Rests on Qfin's Q3 read-through (item 0) on a name that trades on its FY guide, which makes a guide cut or a softened guide the likelier outcome. That is partly offset by the arithmetic that the low end is still reachable (item 2), the buyback headroom, and a stock that has already fallen 11% in 5 days to its 52-week low.

sonnet55.note: Qfin's weak Q3 and Q4 guide as read-through to FINV's revenue guide (name trades on the guide, 15-19% moves), partly priced after -10.7% in 5d and offset by the low-end-already-severe arithmetic; wide implied move of 13.4% with near-coin-flip sign.

fable51.note: Qfin's Q3 print and Q4 guide (volume -40% YoY, Q4 profit -67 to -77%, 3% take rate 'impossible') landed after FINV last spoke and this name moves 11-19% on the guide, so the lean is to a softened FY range; the counterweight that the RMB11.5bn low end already implies a -28% H2 run-rate and the stock's drop to a 52-week low on the Qfin day keep p_up at 41 rather than lower, on the indicative 13.4% implied move.

opus5.note: The BCRA's 2026-11-20 September bank report (item 0) is the only primary document in the pack that the only dated consensus pre-dates: system 3m ROA 2.5% to 0.8%, private domestic banks ~1.75% to ~0.5%, against a Bloomberg ARS219.5bn that implies Macro flat in real terms, with Supervielle's halved Q3 (item 1) and two named brokers 14-18% below consensus corroborating; held to a modest negative because the ADR is already -7.4% in the five sessions since publication, sits 0.16% off its 52-week low with the free control pointing long, the read is system-to-company rather than company-level, and the NPL turn plus an active buyback (items 2-3) are genuine offsets. Item 5 is correctly outside the window: the guide is given on the 11-30 call, after the 11-27 half-day exit.

opus55.note: Rests on the BCRA Q3 system ROA collapse (item 0) against a Bloomberg consensus that implies flat real profit. Supervielle's halved print and the likely restructuring charges add to it. NPL improvement and the buyback offset part of it, and the size is held small by the disputed bar, the proxy nature of the evidence and a tape already at its 52-week low.

sonnet55.note: Rests on the BCRA Sept-2026 system ROA collapse vs a Bloomberg consensus implying flat real profit, plus Supervielle's NIM hit, offset by a turning NPL and buyback; proxy-based, disputed bar and stock already at a 52w low, so only a modest negative lean.

fable51.note: The BCRA September report (system Q3 ROA 0.8% vs 2.5%, private domestic banks ~0.5% vs ~1.75%) and Supervielle's margin collapse sit against a Bloomberg consensus dated before both, so a headline miss is likelier than not; a disputed bar, a 52-week-low tape already -17% in 20 days, improving system NPLs and an active buyback hold p_up near 40 and the findings small on a name with no usable implied move.

opus5.note: The one unpriced asymmetry in the pack is that XYF traded -0.6% on 32.9k shares on 11-25 while QFIN, FINV, LX and YRD fell 8-15%, and the channel Qfin says broke nationwide in Q3 - collections, 30-day rate 88.1% to 86.0% - is exactly the one XYF's CFO credited for its Q2 delinquency improvement (item 0); sized small and barely signed because the bar is wholly unsourced (LESSONS 6 caps every finding on the name), there is no option chain or reaction history, the company told the Q2 call it gives no quantitative guidance so the -15.7% guide channel of Q3 2025 may not fire at all, and the $35.5m unused buyback expiring 11-30 three days after the release (item 1) is a live positive at ~18% of a $190m cap. Item 2's two one-offs genuinely offset, so they are filed at zero rather than dropped.

opus55.note: Rests on the Qfin collection-rate read-through (item 0), which hits the very channel XYF credited for its Q2 improvement, on a stock that did not join the 11-25 peer selloff. That is partly offset by the 30 Nov buyback expiry, which could bring a renewal (item 1). The one-offs net to about zero, the FINV catalyst has no known direction, and there is no bar and no options, so p_up stays close to 50.

sonnet55.note: Qfin collection-rate and Q4-volume read-through that XYF did not reprice (prior guide-driven -15.7%), against the Nov-30 buyback-expiry extension; no bar, no options, thin stock, mild negative lean only.

fable51.note: Qfin's collections and funding squeeze hits the exact channel XYF credited for its Q2 delinquency improvement, and XYF alone did not reprice on 11-25, so the proxy read is the main weight; the $100m buyback expiring 11-30 with $35m unused (18% of market cap) is a real positive binary at the print, and with no bar and no option market everything stays small and p_up near 42.
